## AudioSourceCapture.endedReason property

Why the grant ended, set only when the host or the platform ended it (the host's reason, or `'host-silent'` when frames stopped arriving); `track.readyState` is `'ended'` when this is set. It stays `undefined` after `stop()` — the Tool ended that grant itself, so there is nothing to report back to it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly endedReason?: string;
```
